task_instance: Run the deal-signals sweep in files-only mode: given two uploaded pipeline exports for the same 8-opp personal book one week apart (pipeline_2026-09-20.csv as the prior export, pipeline_2026-09-27.csv as the current export), diff them by hand against the skill's signal set (gone quiet, close-date danger zone, slipped, champion risk, renewal window opening, stale commitment) and produce the short act-today/this-week digest with evidence and suggested actions, noting email/transcript-only signals (competitor mention, inbound waiting) as not queried.
evidence: Created /tmp/.../pipeline_2026-09-20.csv (prior export) and /tmp/.../pipeline_2026-09-27.csv (current export), 8 opps each, owner=example so the default 'my open pipeline' scope was non-empty. Manually swept and diffed the two CSVs field-by-field (no code execution used, just reading and arithmetic) against the skill's 8 signals, applying labeled default assumptions (90-day 'this quarter' window, 120-day renewal lead time, Discovery/Qualification = 'early' stage) since no org/CRM schema was available, per the skill's files-only tier and Step 1 grounding rule. Verified by re-deriving each flagged date delta (e.g. last_activity 2026-08-30 to today 2026-09-27 = 28 days >= 14-day quiet threshold; close_date moved 2026-09-25 -> 2026-10-08 = slipped; primary_contact Alan Petrov -> Ravi Chandran = champion risk; renewal 2027-01-20 minus 120 days = 2026-09-22, already passed = renewal window opening) and cross-checking against both CSV rows before writing them into the digest. Wrote the final deliverable to /tmp/.../deal_signals_digest_2026-09-27.md: an 'act today' block (OPP-1004 Dunmore Retail with 4 stacked signals, OPP-1007 Granite Peak with 2 signals), a 'this week' block (OPP-1001, OPP-1002, OPP-1005, OPP-1006, each with one signal, evidence line and record link), a closing 'nothing else crossed a threshold - 8 opps swept, 2 clean' line, and an explicit note that competitor-mention/inbound-waiting/champion-silence-via-email signals were not queried because no email or transcript connector is available in this runtime (per the skill's 'missing connector' rule, work with what's available and say plainly what was and wasn't used). No CRM/email/calendar write connector was used or needed since this skill only reads and hands fixes off as proposals (update-opportunity / draft-outreach), which were left as suggested text per item rather than executed, since this runtime and task explicitly forbid connector/MCP tool calls. No shell, code execution, or binary file was needed for this task instance, so nothing here hit the office-assistant runtime's limits.
notes_on_runtime_limits: This particular task instance (files-only tier, explicitly designed into the skill for the no-CRM case) needed only reading/writing text (CSV, Markdown) and simple date arithmetic done by inspection, so it fit fully inside the office-assistant's granted abilities. A read-only or gated-writes tier run (live CRM/email/transcript sweep, or an actual update-opportunity/draft-outreach write) would hit missing_tool_in_runtime / forbidden_by_safety_rules respectively, since those require CRM/email MCP connectors this runtime and task explicitly disallow.
